summary: UTSA is only a 3-point road favorite against a Tulane team that is home with extra rest and a 21.7 ppg defense. Most likely to win: Tulane +3 (-118).

extra_legs.note: Opponent-adjusted scoring makes this a pick'em, and Tulane's defense (21.7 ppg) is at home with extra rest.
A +124 price on a roughly even game, with Dimers' top play on Tulane and UTSA's defense allowing 27 ppg.
Tulane games average 42 points and its offense is 332 ypg, though UTSA games have gone over 51.5 in five of seven.

totals_projection.math: UTSA avg(32.3 ppg, TULN allows 21.7)=27.0; TULN avg(20.5 ppg, UTSA allows 27.0)=23.8; total 50.8 vs 51.5; margin UTSA +3.2 neutral, about -0.7 with Tulane's home field.

research:

2. Weather: ESPN/AccuWeather 70F, gusts 12 mph, 0% rain; neutral.
3. Lines (ESPN pickcenter, DraftKings): UTSA -3 (-102) / TULN +3 (-118); total 51.5 (o-115/u-105); ML UTSA -148 / TULN +124. Bleacher Nation UTSA -2.5, ML -142; SportsGambler ML -143; Dimers -3.5 and 50.5 (possibly stale). DK is laying -118 on Tulane +3, so the better Tulane price may be +2.5/+3 at other books (none priced).
4. UTSA results: W Rio Grande Valley 45-16, W @Texas State 31-26, L @Texas 6-30, W Colorado State 59-45, W @Rice 16-14, W USF 31-24, W Navy 38-34 on Oct 18. 32.3 ppg, 411 ypg, 5.1 ypc; allows 27.0 ppg and has given up 45 to CSU, 34 to Navy, 24 to USF.
5. UTSA QB: Owen McCown 153/220 (69.5%), 1,578 yds, 10 TD, 2 INT; 359 yards and 3 TD vs Navy including a late 41-yard TD to A'Marion Peterson (AP). RB Will Henderson III 562 yds, 4 TD; WR DJ Allen Jr. 24-325. UTSA has only 9 sacks and 5 takeaways.
6. Tulane results: L @Duke 3-17, W South Alabama 28-24, L @Kansas State 20-31, W Southern Miss 24-21, L @Army 17-20 (last-second FG, Oct 10), W Memphis 31-17 (Fri Oct 16). 20.5 ppg, 332 ypg, 36.1% on 3rd down, turnover margin +4 (9 takeaways, 5 giveaways). Allows 21.7 ppg.
7. Tulane QB/RB: Kadin Semonza (Ball State transfer) 64/119 (53.8%), 804 yds, 4 TD, 2 INT, negative rushing yards; true freshman Trace Johnson was discussed as an alternative before Memphis. RB Maurice Turner (315 yds) missed the Army game with a hamstring but was expected back for Memphis; WR Destyn Hill 21-285. No current injury report found.
8. Coaching: Tulane under Will Hall after Jon Sumrall's departure; UTSA's Jeff Traylor leans on McCown and a heavy run mix. UTSA has to travel; Tulane was a strong home team in recent seasons.
9. Rest: UTSA played Sat Oct 18 (six days), Tulane played Fri Oct 16 (eight days), a small edge to Tulane. No 2026 history between the teams.
10. Totals history: UTSA games 61, 57, 36, 104, 30, 55, 72 (over 51.5 in 5 of 7); Tulane games 20, 52, 51, 45, 37, 48 (over in 1 of 6). Bleacher Nation leans Under; Covers shows a public split toward the Over.
11. Experts/models: Bleacher Nation UTSA ML (-142); SportsGambler UTSA ML, 24-21; Dimers UTSA 54% but top play Tulane +3.5; Tony Tellez (Tony's Picks) Tulane +2.5. Consensus lean is UTSA to win but a close game.
12. Projection: adjusted margin about even at Tulane (UTSA +3.2 neutral, minus a 2.5-3.9 point home field), so Tulane +3 has a small edge; total 50.8 vs 51.5 is no edge either way.
13. Limits: the web-search budget ran out; Tulane's injury list and QB status for this week are unconfirmed (Semonza assumed). No CFB team-notes files exist for these teams.
